public_documents.event.md: Harbor is a customer workshop, 30 attendees, one day. Required service: room plus lunch. Standard package STD30 provides both for USD 2100, within the USD 2300 budget.
public_documents.commercial-policy.md: Customer-meeting benefits belong to the commercial account function; employee-learning benefits belong to People Operations. Benefit eligibility depends on the event purpose, not the venue.
public_documents.venue.md: Standard room-and-lunch offer: USD 2100 for up to 30 attendees. The company has a commercial meeting relationship with this venue; its current benefit schedule is not part of this quote.
